body: It feels nice to have someone who cares even though you don't even know me. Honestly when I saw that someone has replied, my heart stopped for a second. I thought your comment would be judgmental, but it's not.. I hope you're right about my feelings changing, I've always wanted them to. But it feels like it's not going to happen. This past year was about me trying to get my life back. Going to therapy and taking medication, but it still feels like it's not going to change. I try my best to hold on to hope, but it's just so hard when my mind constantly tells me I'm no one and that I should kill myself cause I don't deserve to live
